name: survival
description: ENGINE TEST FIXTURE, not a played scenario: a full character survival game (gather food, water, and wood, build and warm a shelter, endure hunger, thirst, and cold) kept because most of the engine suite exercises the DSL through it. Played worlds run genesis.

dynamicRules.description: Every character grows hungrier each tick; eating is what holds it back.
When a character's hunger maxes out, their health starts draining.
Fires once when a character first becomes starving — the hunger alarm.

emit.interrupt: you are starving - eat from your pack now, or make getting food your only task

dynamicRules.description: Fires once when a character's health first drops to a critical level — the last-chance warning.

emit.interrupt: your health is critical - stop and see to your survival before anything else

dynamicRules.description: When a character's health hits zero they die: untagged out of the living and left as a corpse.
Eat food from your own pack to ease your hunger, gathered from a source or taken from a stockpile.
dynamicRules.requireReason: must be carrying food to eat

dynamicRules.description: Build a finished shelter where you stand for 4 carried wood, on dry ground with no shelter already here.
dynamicRules.requireReason: need 4 carried wood and dry ground with no shelter underfoot

dynamicRules.description: A finished shelter blunts the cold for anyone beside it - the payoff for raising it before winter.
A fed and watered but freezing character can't heal, sharing recover-when-comfortable's fed/watered gate and cancelling its +1 while warmth has run down so the two rules compose additively.
The cold steadily saps every character's warmth, doubled in winter (see winter-deepens-cold), held back by the camp hearth.
A character who runs out of warmth starts taking cold damage.
Fires once when a character first grows dangerously cold.
In winter the cold drains warmth faster - and each successive winter is colder than the last: 2x the first year, +0.5x per year after.
Walking costs energy per tile entered.
Every character grows thirstier each tick; drinking holds it back.
A character whose thirst maxes out starts losing health.
A fed and watered character slowly regains health, with survival-cold layering a matching penalty (cold-stalls-recovery) that cancels this gain while freezing.
Fires once when a character first becomes dangerously thirsty.

emit.interrupt: you are dangerously thirsty - drink now

dynamicRules.description: Drink from open water to slake thirst by standing on a tile next to water, since water itself is impassable.
dynamicRules.requireReason: must stand on a land tile directly touching a water tile

dynamicRules.description: Gather food from a source you're next to into your pack, as much as will fit, from a finite reserve, then eat it or haul it to a stockpile.
dynamicRules.requireReason: must be next to a food source that still has food, with room in your pack

dynamicRules.description: Wild food patches regrow on their own, but only slowly - enough to keep a small band fed off the land, never enough to sustain a growing colony.
Rest to recover energy, anywhere.
A sown farm plot grows faster than the wild land but tending it is what really brings the crop in, sleeping through winter like all growth (see winter-stills-crops).
Break open a patch of open plains to sow a new farm plot where you stand, tiring work needing dry, open ground.
dynamicRules.requireReason: need open, dry plains ground and the energy to break the soil

dynamicRules.description: Tend a farm plot to coax up its crop by standing on it, tiring work that only works while the growing season lasts.
dynamicRules.requireReason: must stand on a farm plot during the growing season (crops won't take in winter)

dynamicRules.description: A lit hearth burns its fuel down a little every tick, tended or not - the colony's shared drain.
A character beside a lit hearth soaks up its warmth and a little cheer.
Fires once when a hearth's fuel first burns low - the call for someone to fetch wood.
Fires once when a hearth goes cold.
Feed your carried wood into a hearth to keep it burning, from a tile beside it.
dynamicRules.requireReason: must be beside a hearth and carry wood

dynamicRules.description: Build a campfire where you stand for 2 carried wood on dry ground, so the colony has a hearth to gather round.
dynamicRules.requireReason: need 2 carried wood and dry ground

dynamicRules.description: Gnawing hunger erodes a character's morale.
Bitter cold erodes a character's morale.
A well-fed character regains heart.
Working within sight of another character keeps spirits up - solitude wears them down.
Fires once when a character's morale first collapses.
Predators roam: every 3 ticks each drifts one tile in a seeded random direction (no pathfinding).
A beast sharing a character's tile mauls them, costing health and nerve.
Fires once when a beast first prowls within sight of the camp hearth - the call to drive it off together.
Fight a beast on your tile - your blow lands on the most wounded one so fighters finishing a beast together converge - bloody and tiring work best shared.
dynamicRules.requireReason: must share a tile with a living beast

dynamicRules.description: When a beast's health hits zero it is slain, leaving a carcass laden with meat for the colony to butcher.
Butcher a slain beast where it fell, cutting as much meat as will fit into your pack, since a big carcass feeds several.
dynamicRules.requireReason: must stand over a carcass that still has meat, with room in your pack
dynamicRules.fizzleReason: the carcass was stripped bare before you got your share

dynamicRules.description: A carcass stripped of all its meat is cleared away - nothing left to butcher.
Fell a tree for wood by standing next to it and chopping; felling it clears the tree away, leaving open plains.
dynamicRules.requireReason: must be next to a tree that still has timber
dynamicRules.fizzleReason: the trees here are logged out

dynamicRules.description: A tree chopped bare of all its timber is cleared away, leaving open plains.

The world's season, derived from the clock (year = 100 ticks, four 25-tick seasons): 0 is growing season (ticks 0-74), 0.5 is winter approaching (ticks 67-74), and 1 is winter (ticks 75-99), computed as a derived stock so season watches see a fresh crossing.
In winter nothing grows - neither wild food patches nor sown farm plots regrow until the thaw - a world-level effect that holds for whichever growth rules are active.
Fires once each year, a stretch before winter lands - the colony's warning to stockpile wood and food.
Fires once when winter lands.
Fires once when winter breaks.

Clear a patch of ground and declare it a stockpile pile by standing where you want it, then announce the spot so others can travel here. Each pile holds one resource type, so found a separate pile for food, wood, stone, and so on.
dynamicRules.requireReason: there is already a stockpile on this tile

dynamicRules.description: Store one carried resource in this pile. Each pile is dedicated to the first resource type deposited (20 max), so take a different resource to a different pile.

params.name: item
params.description: which carried resource to unload onto the pile

dynamicRules.requireReason: must carry the resource and stand on a compatible stockpile with space
dynamicRules.fizzleReason: the stockpile filled or was claimed for another resource

dynamicRules.description: Take a chosen resource from the stockpile you stand on into your own pack, taking as much as will fit.

params.name: item
params.description: which stored resource to take into your pack

dynamicRules.requireReason: must stand on the stockpile, it must hold the resource you name, and your pack must have room for it
dynamicRules.fizzleReason: the pile was emptied before you could take any

dynamicRules.description: Keep at least one character alive through the first 100-tick year to survive winter and win.

emit.text: Spring returns with the colony alive - the first winter is won!

describeEvent.ate: {{ ctx.name }} eats from their pack (hunger {{ ctx.stocks.hunger.value }}).
describeEvent.critical: {{ ctx.name }} is in critical condition (health {{ ctx.stocks.health.value }}).
describeEvent.gathered: {{ ctx.name }} gathers food into their pack (carrying {{ ctx.stocks.food.value }}).
describeEvent.sowed: {{ ctx.name }} breaks ground and sows a new farm plot.
describeEvent.stoked: {{ ctx.name }} feeds wood into the hearth.
describeEvent.hearth_low: The hearth burns low ({{ ctx.stocks.fuel.value }} fuel left).
describeEvent.butchered: {{ ctx.name }} butchers the carcass for meat (carrying {{ ctx.stocks.food.value }}).
describeEvent.wolf_at_camp: {{ ctx.name }} is prowling near the camp!
describeEvent.winter_soon: The air turns crisp. Winter is coming - stockpile wood and food.
describeEvent.winter_arrived: Winter has arrived. The cold deepens and nothing grows.
describeEvent.spring_thaw: The thaw has come - winter has passed.
describeEvent.deposited: {{ ctx.name }} unloads a haul onto a stockpile.
describeEvent.withdrew: {{ ctx.name }} takes a load from a stockpile.
describeEvent.victory: Spring returns with the colony alive - the first winter is won!

bands.serious: You are very hungry - find food soon.
bands.critical: You are starving. Eat now, or getting food is your only task.

bands.serious: You are parched - find water soon.
bands.critical: You are dying of thirst. Drink now, or getting water is your only task.
You are about to drop where you stand.
